comments.body: Fixed: Strengthened Bug-Fix Mode SKILL.md language in debug-everything. The HARD-GATE at Bug-Fix Mode entry and Step 2 now explicitly list prohibited behaviors (reading source files, writing fixes, dispatching general-purpose agents with inline fix prompts, skipping fix-bug because the bug 'looks simple'). Step 2 now includes a PROHIBITED block that clarifies the orchestrator's role is to follow fix-bug/SKILL.md as an instruction script — the orchestrator coordinates, fix-bug's sub-agents investigate and fix. The previous 'execute its steps directly' phrasing was ambiguous and has been replaced with unambiguous delegation language. File: plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md
